agent.task: self-alignment against the parent — the double condition (not-filling AND the mode allows that axis)

That reframed it from damage to refactor, and git confirmed: framework.css now reads '⚠ The ONLY @layer statement on the site. View.js puts this file first in <head>.' The other run consolidated 30+ duplicated declarations into one. That is 'fix the cause once' and 'deleting beats adding' done properly, and my instinct to report was the wrong instinct.

VERIFIED ITS PREMISE rather than taking the comment's word, because the whole refactor rests on one claim — that View.js puts framework.css first. Measured live on /framework/ext/Panel/: 70 stylesheets in the document, framework.css at index 0, and the only CSSLayerStatementRule in any of them is at index 0 and reads `@layer base, theme, site, util;`. The premise holds and the cascade is intact. That is the check the refactor deserved and the one its author could not perform on themselves as cheaply as an outsider can.

Also noted without acting: ext/doc has been renamed ext/Doc (app.js imports ./framework/ext/Doc/Doc.js). Second rename today after LayoutTool→DesignTool. Renames are where dangling imports hide — I caught one for the first rename — so the next cycle's sweep is worth running specifically for that, once this one settles. Budget: session 40%, weekly 43%. My stand-down line is 45.

Checked the ext/doc→ext/Doc rename for the one failure mode that does NOT show up locally: a case-only rename on case-insensitive NTFS looks fine on this machine while breaking on a case-SENSITIVE deploy target (LAW#2 — production is Cloudflare static assets). `ls` shows both ext/doc and ext/Doc because Windows folds them into one directory, which is the same trap CLAUDE.md records for Panel.js/panel.js. Verdict: CLEAN. git has the files recorded as ext/Doc/ (capital), every import in public/ asks for framework/ext/Doc/, and there are zero live imports of the old lowercase path. The rename was done properly, casing and all — worth stating positively, because had git kept the lowercase path while imports moved to the capital, the site would work here and 404 on deploy with nothing to see locally.

⚠ I WAS WRONG TO STAND DOWN, and the correction is worth more than the stand-down was. The skill's budget doctrine has been REPLACED: no fixed cap, one rule — used% <= elapsed%. I had been governing against the old 45/50 thresholds and had floored myself at weekly 47%. A rule about a fixed number and a rule about a RATE give opposite answers at the same reading, and I was enforcing a ceiling that no longer existed — three cycles of noop that the budget did not ask for.

Resumed with the work my own cycle-35 reassessment already named, which is now also the skill's first objective: a DELETION task. **38 cycles, 21 agents, one module turned into a tool and then made smaller than the day it grew.** [ext/Panel](/framework/ext/Panel/) · [full window](/framework/ext/Panel/full/) · [ext/drawer](/framework/ext/drawer/)

**Built:** twelve gestures on a panel, text that persists a reload, per-axis sizing, self-alignment, `position`, live duplicates. **Caught, all by measurement:** an overlay leak (listeners 1,696→17,775 over 20 redraws, now flat at +0) · `split()`/`close()` silently blanking every mirror · a regression where ext/editor inherited 45 alignment arrows · a bad `icon:` widening the whole framework sidebar 231→344px · `**/` inside a block comment closing it and killing nine pages · a dangling import left by the LayoutTool→DesignTool rename.

**Nine of 21 agents corrected the brief that sent them**, three of them correcting me: `fixed`/`sticky` proved impossible where I had assumed them buildable; `mode: hug` was never both axes; the leak agent reverted its own fix to prove the gap was real.

**Governance:** ran alongside a second mastermind all day without a collision — lanes declared in day.jsonl, seams smoke-tested after every shared-file edit. I also stood down for three cycles against a budget rule that had been replaced, and corrected it when I re-read the doctrine.

**Spend:** 21 agents / 4.04M subagent tokens (6 Opus, 13 Sonnet, 2 Haiku) + 508k my own. Weekly 55% against 67% elapsed — under pace. `/data/panels.json` never written.
